claims.object_text: protein subunit of the GATOR1 complex
claims.quote: Dishevelled, Egl-10 and Pleckstrin (DEP) domain-containing protein 5 (DEPDC5) is a protein subunit of the GTPase-activating proteins towards Rags 1 (GATOR1) complex.

claims.object_text: modulator of mTOR activity via GATOR1
claims.quote: GATOR1 is a recently identified modulator of mechanistic target of rapamycin (mTOR) activity.
GATOR1 gene mutations have recently been shown to cause lesional and non-lesional focal epilepsy.
DEPDC5 is an attractive therapeutic target in focal epilepsy, as effects of DEPDC5 agonists would likely be anti-epileptogenic and more selective than currently available mTOR inhibitors.
Therapeutic effects might be synergistic with certain existing dietary therapies, including the ketogenic diet.
